llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文不涉及生物力学建模、有限元分析或植入物力学性能，完全为临床手术综述。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical surgical review on revision techniques, with no biomechanics modeling, stress analysis, micromotion quantification, or implant design considerations.

summary_zh.motivation: 汇总髋关节表面置换翻修为全髋置换的手术要点
summary_zh.method: 回顾文献和经验，总结手术技巧和陷阱
summary_zh.result: 提供了术中注意事项和避免并发症的建议

summary_en.motivation: To compile surgical pearls and pitfalls when converting a failed hip resurfacing to total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A narrative review of surgical techniques based on literature and expert experience.
summary_en.result: Key recommendations are provided for intraoperative management and complication avoidance.
summary_en.validation: No validation; it is a review article.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究肱骨近端应力，而非股骨近端，且未涉及髋关节植入物。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on the humerus and shoulder implants, not the femur or hip implant stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较不同长度肱骨柄对近端肱骨应力分布的影响
summary_zh.method: 使用有限元分析模拟三种肱骨柄植入后的骨应力
summary_zh.result: 短柄和无柄设计能减少近端应力遮挡
summary_zh.validation: 仅基于有限元模拟，无实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To compare proximal humeral bone stresses among stemless, short stem, and standard stem length implants.
summary_en.method: Finite element models of the humerus with three stem designs were developed and analyzed.
summary_en.result: Stemless and short stem designs reduce proximal stress shielding compared to standard stems.
summary_en.validation: The study is purely computational without experimental validation.
